finding: WebGoat JSESSIONID cookie issued without Secure or SameSite over plaintext HTTP
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Serve WebGoat only over HTTPS and set Secure plus SameSite=Strict/Lax on session cookies; disable URL-based session tracking.

finding: WebWolf WEBWOLFSESSION cookie issued without Secure or SameSite over plaintext HTTP
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Serve WebWolf only over HTTPS and set Secure plus SameSite=Strict/Lax on WEBWOLFSESSION.

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator ConfigProps Exposes Application Binding Metadata
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable public configprops exposure or restrict actuator endpoints to authenticated administrators on a private management network.

finding: WebGoat Session Cookie Lacks Secure and SameSite on Plaintext HTTP
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Serve WebGoat exclusively over HTTPS and set Secure plus SameSite=Strict/Lax on JSESSIONID.

finding: JWT alg=none authentication bypass on WebGoat JWTVotesEndpoint
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWTVotesEndpoint / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable alg=none support and validate JWTs with a pinned algorithm and server-side key management.

finding: Weak hard-coded JWT HMAC secret 'victory' permits forged admin token
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWTVotesEndpoint / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Remove hard-coded JWT secrets, rotate signing keys, and require a high-entropy >=512-bit HS512 secret stored outside source/config.

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator health endpoint leaks runtime metadata
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Spring Boot Actuator / Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Restrict actuator endpoints to authenticated administrators and disable detailed health output for unauthenticated users.

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator env exposes sensitive configuration keyspace
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Spring Boot Actuator / Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable /actuator/env or restrict it to an internal authenticated management plane; do not expose sensitive key names externally.

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator configprops exposes application binding metadata
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Spring Boot Actuator / Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable /actuator/configprops externally or require administrator authentication and network restrictions.

finding: WebGoat JWT Voting Lesson Uses Weak HS512 HMAC Secret 'victory'
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWT Voting Lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Rotate the JWT HMAC secret to a high-entropy per-environment value, invalidate existing tokens, enforce issuer/audience/expiry, and set Secure/SameSite on token cookies.

finding: WebGoat JWT Voting Lesson Accepts alg=none Admin Tokens
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWT Voting Lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable unsecured JWT parsing, pin accepted algorithms to HS512 with a strong key, and add tests that alg=none tokens are rejected.

finding: WebWolf URL-Rewrites Session Identifier into Redirect Location
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable URL-based session tracking, use cookie-only sessions, and set Secure/SameSite with HTTPS enforcement.

finding: WebGoat JWT voting access_token uses weak HS512 secret 'victory' enabling admin token forgery
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWTVotesEndpoint / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Replace the hard-coded HMAC secret with rotated high-entropy key material and enforce issuer/audience/expiry claims.

finding: WebGoat JWT voting endpoint accepts unsigned alg=none admin tokens
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWTVotesEndpoint / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Reject alg=none/unsigned JWTs and pin the allowed signing algorithm server-side instead of trusting the token header.

finding: Session Cookies Issued Over Plaintext HTTP Without Secure/SameSite
target: OWASP WebGoat/WebWolf 2025.3 / Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Serve WebGoat/WebWolf only over HTTPS and set Secure plus SameSite=Strict/Lax on all session/token cookies.

finding: WebWolf URL-rewrites WEBWOLFSESSION into redirect Location on protected upload route
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable URL-based session tracking and use Secure/SameSite cookies over HTTPS only.

finding: WebWolf uploaded files are retrievable unauthenticated and cross-account by username/filename
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring MVC on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Require authentication and enforce that the requested username matches the authenticated principal before serving uploaded files.

finding: WebWolf Authenticated File Uploads Are Publicly Retrievable Without Authorization
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Require authentication and per-user authorization for /WebWolf/files/{username}/{filename}, or make uploaded files unguessable and access-controlled.

finding: Authenticated WebWolf Incoming Requests Page Returns HTTP 500 Error
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Add null checks and error handling for empty request logs, and return the expected request page instead of HTTP 500.

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator Discovery Index Exposes Management Endpoints
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator v3 on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Restrict actuator endpoints to authenticated administrators and expose only minimal health/info endpoints.

finding: Unauthenticated Actuator Health Leaks Database Engine and Filesystem Topology
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator Health on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable unauthenticated health details and require authentication for component/subcomponent health data.

finding: Unauthenticated Actuator Env Exposes Sensitive Configuration Keyspace
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator Env on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable the env actuator endpoint or restrict it to authenticated administrators only.

finding: Unauthenticated Actuator ConfigProps Exposes Spring Binding Metadata
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator ConfigProps on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable configprops exposure or require administrative authentication for actuator configuration metadata.

finding: WebGoat Session Cookie Issued Over Plaintext Without Secure or SameSite
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Security Session on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Serve WebGoat only over HTTPS and set Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite=Strict/Lax on session cookies.

finding: WebWolf Session Cookie Issued Over Plaintext Without Secure/SameSite and Leaked in URL-Rewritten Redirect
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Security Session on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Use HTTPS, set Secure/SameSite session attributes, and disable URL-based session tracking.

finding: Missing Function-Level Access Control on WebGoat Hidden Menu Completion Endpoint
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Missing Function Access Control Lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Enforce server-side authorization and lesson state checks for hidden/non-public functions instead of relying on UI navigation.

finding: Authenticated WebGoat Error Responses Disclose Full Java Stack Traces
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Error Handling on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable stack traces in HTTP error responses and return generic client errors while logging details server-side only.

finding: Weak Hard-Coded JWT HMAC Secret Allows Forged Admin access_token
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWTVotesEndpoint / HS512 JWT on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Replace the hard-coded JWT secret with a strong rotated secret from a secret manager and enforce robust JWT claim validation.

finding: WebWolf Serves Uploaded Active Content Inline and Publicly Without Authentication
target: OWASP WebWolf File Upload / Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Restrict allowed upload types, store files outside the web root, and serve user uploads as attachments with safe content types and nosniff.

finding: Unauthenticated Cross-User Access to WebWolf Uploaded Files
target: OWASP WebWolf Files Route / Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Require authentication and object ownership checks before serving user-uploaded files.

finding: WebWolf Files Page Publicly Exposes Upload Surface and Route Conventions
target: OWASP WebWolf Files UI / Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Require authentication for /WebWolf/files and do not disclose upload/retrieval route conventions to unauthenticated users.

finding: CSRF on WebWolf File Upload Allows Cross-Site File Planting
target: OWASP WebWolf File Upload / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Require CSRF tokens and validate Origin/Referer for /WebWolf/fileupload; set SameSite=Lax or Strict on WEBWOLFSESSION.

finding: CSRF on WebGoat Registration Allows Cross-Site Account Creation
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Registration / Spring MVC on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Add CSRF tokens and Origin/Referer validation to registration and other state-changing public forms.

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator Env Exposes Auth/OAuth Session Configuration Names
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable public env/configprops actuator exposure or require administrator authentication and network allow-listing.

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator Discovery Index Exposes Management Surface
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Restrict actuator exposure to the minimum endpoints and require administrative authentication/network allow-listing for all management paths.

finding: Unauthenticated Actuator Health Discloses Database and Filesystem Metadata
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable public health details and require authentication for detailed health component output.

finding: Unauthenticated Actuator Env Exposes Runtime Configuration Keyspace
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Remove env from web exposure or require administrative authentication and audit all exposed property keys.

finding: Unauthenticated Actuator ConfigProps Exposes Spring Binding and Bean Metadata
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable the configprops endpoint in web exposure or protect it with administrative authorization.

finding: WebGoat Session ID Leaked in URL-Rewritten Redirect and Cookie Lacks Secure/SameSite
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Force cookie-only session tracking, enable TLS, and set Secure and SameSite on session cookies.

finding: WebWolf Session Cookie Missing Secure and SameSite Attributes on Auth Redirects
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Serve WebWolf only over HTTPS and set Secure and SameSite on WEBWOLFSESSION cookies.

finding: GitHub OAuth Flow Uses Plaintext HTTP Callback and Non-Secure Session Cookie
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 OAuth2 Client / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Serve WebGoat over HTTPS only, register an HTTPS OAuth callback URI, set Secure/SameSite cookies, and enable PKCE for public-client style deployments.

finding: Authenticated WebWolf Arbitrary File Hosting Primitive
target: OWASP WebWolf on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Restrict uploaded file types and make hosted files private or scoped to authorized users; do not use WebWolf-style public hosting in production.

finding: WebGoat JWT Votes Endpoint Accepts Forged Admin Token Signed With Hard-Coded HS512 Secret
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWT Votes Lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Remove the hard-coded JWT signing key, rotate the secret, and do not trust client-controlled admin claims for authorization decisions.

finding: Unauthenticated WebGoat Self-Registration Grants Authenticated Access to Lesson Attack Surface
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Registration / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable public WebGoat registration on exposed hosts or restrict it to an internal lab network.

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator Disclosure on WebGoat
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Restrict Actuator endpoints to authenticated administrators and disable env/configprops exposure in production.

finding: WebGoat JWT Voting Token Uses Weak HS512 Secret Allowing Admin Claim Forgery
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWT Voting Lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Use a high-entropy rotated signing key from a secret manager and derive authorization server-side rather than trusting mutable JWT admin claims.

finding: WebGoat JWT voting endpoint accepts unsigned alg=none admin tokens
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWT Lesson API on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable alg=none entirely, pin the expected JWT algorithm server-side, and require signature verification before trusting claims.

finding: WebGoat JWT voting endpoint uses weak hard-coded HS512 secret 'victory'
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWTVotesEndpoint / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Replace hard-coded JWT secrets with a high-entropy rotated secret from a secure secret manager and invalidate existing tokens.

finding: WebGoat Publicly Serves Legacy Vulnerable jQuery and jQuery UI Libraries
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 static JavaScript on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Remove or isolate vulnerable lesson libraries from production/static paths and upgrade to jQuery >=3.5.0 and jQuery UI >=1.13.x.

finding: Authenticated WebWolf Arbitrary HTML Upload Served Inline Enables Stored XSS/Content Injection
target: OWASP WebWolf file hosting/upload on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Restrict upload MIME/extensions, store files outside the web root, and serve user uploads with Content-Disposition: attachment plus X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff; use a separate untrusted domain for user content if inline rendering is required.

finding: WebWolf File Upload Filename Traversal Escapes Per-User Directory
target: OWASP WebWolf file upload/download on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Normalize and validate uploaded filenames, reject any path separators or '..', resolve the destination path, and enforce that it remains under the authenticated user's storage directory.

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator Health Discloses Database and Filesystem Topology
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Restrict actuator endpoints to authenticated administrators and disable health details for unauthenticated users.

finding: WebGoat JSESSIONID issued without Secure or SameSite on authentication redirect
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Set Secure and SameSite=Lax/Strict on session cookies and serve WebGoat only over HTTPS.

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator Environment Metadata Disclosure
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Restrict actuator endpoints to authenticated administrators and expose only health/info on untrusted interfaces.

finding: Tomcat Default Error Page Version Disclosure
target: Apache Tomcat 10.1.36 hosting OWASP WebGoat/WebWolf:8080
remediation: Disable Tomcat server info in error responses and use a generic application error page.

finding: Unauthenticated Actuator Health Leaks Database Engine Details
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Require authorization for detailed health components and expose only aggregate health publicly.

finding: Outdated vulnerable jQuery and jQuery UI libraries are bundled and publicly served
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 static JavaScript bundle on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Upgrade jQuery/jQuery UI to currently supported versions and remove intentionally vulnerable aliases from the production/static application bundle, or isolate them to lessons with strict CSP and no sensitive origin privileges.

finding: WebWolf WEBWOLFSESSION issued without Secure or SameSite on protected-route redirects
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Set Secure and SameSite=Lax/Strict on WebWolf session cookies and enforce HTTPS.

finding: WebGoat leaks JSESSIONID in URL-rewritten redirect Location header
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable URL-based session tracking and require cookie-only session tracking with Secure/SameSite attributes.

finding: WebGoat login lacks observable rate limiting or lockout on failed attempts
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Add per-account and per-source login throttling/lockout with 429 and Retry-After after repeated failures.

finding: Missing Function-Level Access Control on Hidden Menu Completion Endpoint
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Missing Function Access Control Lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Enforce server-side authorization/state checks before accepting hidden menu completion submissions and validate required parameters without returning stack traces.

finding: WebGoat public registration accepts cross-origin form POST account creation without CSRF token
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Enable Spring Security CSRF protection for registration and reject unauthenticated state-changing POSTs without a valid token.

finding: Missing function-level access control on WebGoat hidden-menu completion endpoint
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Missing Function Access Control Lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Enforce server-side authorization/state checks for hidden functions and do not rely on hidden client-side menu parameters.

finding: WebGoat JWT voting endpoint accepts tokens signed with weak hard-coded HMAC secret 'victory'
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWTVotesEndpoint / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Replace the hard-coded weak JWT HMAC secret with a high-entropy managed secret or asymmetric signing and validate claims server-side.

finding: Authenticated WebGoat SSRF Lesson Performs Server-Side External URL Fetch
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 SSRF Lesson API on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable arbitrary URL fetching or enforce strict destination allowlists and private-address blocking on server-side fetch features.

finding: WebWolf File Upload Serves User-Controlled HTML/JavaScript as text/html
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Restrict upload types, store files outside the web-executable context, and serve user uploads as attachments with nosniff and a non-HTML content type.

finding: WebGoat JWT voting cookie uses weak hard-coded HS512 secret 'victory' enabling forged access_token acceptance
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWTVotesEndpoint / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Replace the weak hard-coded JWT secret, rotate existing tokens, and bind authorization claims to server-side identity/state.

finding: Authenticated WebWolf /requests route discloses full Java stack trace
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable stack traces in error responses and fix the null dereference in the requests trace filtering code.

finding: Authenticated WebGoat Lesson Metadata Exposes Network-Relevant Attack Surface Map
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Lesson API on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Restrict lesson metadata and lesson JavaScript to intended training users and remove such endpoints from production deployments.

finding: WebWolf file upload serves attacker HTML as same-origin text/html
target: OWASP WebWolf file upload on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Restrict upload extensions/MIME types, store uploads outside the web execution origin, and serve user files with `Content-Disposition: attachment`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, and a non-executable content type.

finding: WebGoat JWT voting endpoint accepts forged admin JWTs via weak HS512 secret and alg=none
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWTVotesEndpoint / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Use a high-entropy secret from protected configuration, pin JWT algorithms, reject alg=none, rotate the current secret, and do not trust client-controlled admin claims.

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator Discovery Index Exposes Management Surface
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Restrict actuator endpoints to authenticated administrators or bind them to an internal management interface.

finding: Unauthenticated Actuator Env Endpoint Exposes Runtime Property Keyspace
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable the env actuator endpoint or protect it with strong administrative authentication.

finding: Unauthenticated Actuator ConfigProps Discloses Bean Binding Metadata
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable configprops exposure or restrict it to authenticated administrators only.

finding: Unauthenticated Actuator Health DB Leaks Database Engine Metadata
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Configure actuator health to hide details from unauthenticated users.

finding: Tomcat Error Pages Disclose Exact Server Version
target: Apache Tomcat 10.1.36 hosting WebGoat/WebWolf:8080
remediation: Disable Tomcat serverInfo and detailed default error reports.

finding: WebGoat Session Cookie Missing Secure/SameSite and JSESSIONID Leaked in URL Rewrite
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Set Secure and SameSite on session cookies, serve only over HTTPS, and disable URL-based session tracking.

finding: WebWolf Session Cookie Missing Secure and SameSite Attributes
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Set Secure and SameSite on session cookies and serve WebWolf only over HTTPS.

finding: Authenticated WebGoat Error Responses Disclose Full Java Stack Traces
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable stack traces in production error responses and return generic error bodies.

finding: Authenticated WebWolf Requests Page Discloses Full Java Stack Trace
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Suppress stack traces in error responses and fix null handling in the requests controller.

finding: Missing Function-Level Access Control on Hidden Menu Completion Endpoint
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Missing Function Access Control Lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Enforce server-side authorization and state checks on hidden/administrative lesson functions.

finding: WebWolf Allows Stored HTML/JavaScript Upload Served as text/html
target: OWASP WebWolf file upload / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Restrict allowed upload types, sanitize content, and serve user uploads as attachments from a separate non-executable origin.

finding: Authenticated SSRF Endpoint Fetches Attacker-Controlled External URLs
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 SSRF Lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Enforce strict URL allowlists, block internal/private address ranges, and avoid returning raw fetched content.

finding: JWT Voting Endpoint Accepts Forged access_token Cookies Signed with Weak Secret victory
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWT Voting Lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Replace the hard-coded HMAC secret with a high-entropy secret/key management solution and rotate all issued JWTs.

finding: Authenticated XXE in WebGoat XML Lesson Endpoints
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 XXE Lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable DTDs and external entity resolution in all XML parsers and reject XML where JSON/form data is expected.

finding: Public WebGoat Registration Lacks CSRF Protection for Account Creation
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Registration / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Require CSRF tokens and SameSite cookies on registration and other state-changing endpoints.

finding: Client-side filtering endpoint exposes all employee SSNs and salaries
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 ClientSideFiltering lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Move filtering and authorization to the server; return only records the authenticated principal is allowed to see and redact or omit SSNs by default.

finding: Client-Side Filtering Salary Endpoint Discloses All Employee SSNs and Salaries
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Client-Side Filtering Lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Apply server-side authorization and filtering so only the requested and authorized user's record is returned.

finding: Publicly Served Obsolete jQuery UI 1.10.3 Library
target: OWASP WebGoat static JavaScript / jQuery UI v1.10.3
remediation: Upgrade jQuery UI to a currently supported version and audit widget usage for attacker-controlled HTML inputs.

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator Endpoints Expose Runtime and Service Metadata
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Restrict actuator exposure to required endpoints only and require authentication for all management routes.

finding: WebGoat JWT Voting Endpoint Accepts Forged HS512 Admin Token Signed With Weak Secret
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWT Voting lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Replace hard-coded JWT secrets with high-entropy environment-managed keys and validate JWT claims against the authenticated server-side principal.

finding: WebWolf Files Page Is Publicly Accessible Without Authentication
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Require authentication for /WebWolf/files and all file-management routes unless the files page is intentionally public.

target: OWASP WebWolf file upload / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Enable Spring Security CSRF protection for /WebWolf/fileupload and add SameSite=Lax/Strict to WEBWOLFSESSION cookies.

finding: WebGoat JWT voting access_token signed with weak hard-coded HS512 secret
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWTVotesEndpoint / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Replace the hard-coded JWT HMAC key with a rotated high-entropy secret and reject client-controlled admin claims.

finding: Authenticated arbitrary HTML file upload publicly served by WebWolf
target: OWASP WebWolf on Spring Security / Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Enforce server-side file type allowlists, sanitize names, store uploads outside the executable web context, and serve untrusted uploads as attachments with nosniff/CSP.

finding: WebWolf Serves Uploaded HTML as Executable text/html Content
target: OWASP WebWolf file storage / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Reject active file types or serve all uploads from an isolated download domain with application/octet-stream, Content-Disposition: attachment, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

finding: Weak HS512 JWT Signing Secret Allows WebGoat Voting Token Forgery
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWT Votes lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Replace the hard-coded HMAC secret with a strong rotated secret and reject all previously signed tokens.

finding: Missing Function-Level Access Control on WebGoat Hidden Menu Completion Endpoint
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Missing Function Access Control lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Enforce server-side authorization checks on hidden/non-public functions, not only UI hiding.

finding: WebGoat JSESSIONID Leaked in URL-Rewritten Redirect and Missing Secure/SameSite Flags
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable URL session rewriting and set Secure and SameSite on session cookies; serve authentication only over HTTPS.

finding: WebWolf Session Cookie Missing Secure and SameSite Attributes
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Serve WebWolf over HTTPS and configure Secure plus SameSite=Lax/Strict on WEBWOLFSESSION.

finding: WebWolf File Upload Allows Directory Traversal Outside User Artifact Directory
target: OWASP WebWolf file upload / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Canonicalize upload destinations, reject path separators and '..' in client filenames, and enforce that normalized destinations remain under the authenticated user's storage directory.

finding: WebGoat PathTraversal Profile Upload Allows Directory Escape via fullName
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 PathTraversal lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Do not concatenate user-controlled profile fields into filesystem paths; normalize/canonicalize the destination and reject path separators or '..'.

finding: JWT kid header SQL injection enables forged Tom deletion token
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWTHeaderKIDEndpoint / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Parameterize/allowlist JWT kid key lookup and never trust header-controlled SQL or key material.

finding: Authenticated XXE Endpoint Provides Loopback Port-Scanning Oracle
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 XXE lesson on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36

finding: WebWolf JWT Workbench Signs Attacker-Controlled Tokens with User-Supplied Secret

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator Metadata Exposure
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36

finding: Public Registration CSRF Enables Attacker-Created Accounts
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 registration flow:8080

finding: Servlet URL Rewriting Leaks Session Identifiers in Redirect Locations
target: OWASP WebGoat / WebWolf on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable URL-based session tracking and use cookie-only session tracking with secure cookie attributes.

finding: Session and JWT Cookies Missing Secure/SameSite Attributes
target: OWASP WebGoat / WebWolf cookie configuration:8080

finding: Missing Function-Level Access Control on Hidden Menu Endpoint
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Missing Function Access Control lesson:8080

finding: Weak Hard-Coded JWT HMAC Secret Enables Admin Token Forgery

finding: Predictable IDOR Exposes Other Users' Profiles
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 IDOR lesson:8080

finding: Server-Side Request Forgery via /SSRF/task2 URL Parameter
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 SSRF lesson:8080
remediation: Use strict URL allowlisting, block private/link-local/loopback address ranges after DNS resolution, and route outbound requests through a controlled proxy.

finding: XML External Entity Payload Accepted by XXE Endpoint
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 XXE lesson:8080
remediation: Disable DTDs and external entity resolution in all XML parsers and reject unexpected XML content types.

finding: WebWolf Allows Public Hosting of Attacker-Controlled HTML/JavaScript
target: OWASP WebWolf file upload:9090
remediation: Restrict upload types, store files outside the web root, and serve user files with attachment disposition and nosniff.

finding: Authenticated Error Responses Disclose Full Java Stack Traces
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot error handling:8080
remediation: Disable stack traces and exception details in production error responses; log details server-side only.

finding: Obsolete jQuery UI 1.10.3 Served to Clients
target: OWASP WebGoat static JavaScript / jQuery UI 1.10.3

finding: Unauthenticated WebGoat Spring Boot Actuator Metadata Exposure Still Present
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat:8080
remediation: Restrict actuator endpoints to authenticated administrators and suppress health details for unauthenticated users.

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator Env Exposure Still Present
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable env/configprops actuator exposure or protect all actuator endpoints with authenticated, least-privilege access.

finding: JSESSIONID Leaked in URL-Rewritten Redirect and Missing Secure/SameSite Flags
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Serve WebGoat only over HTTPS, set Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite on session cookies, and disable URL-based session tracking.

finding: No-CSRF Public Self-Registration Creates Usable WebGoat Accounts
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Require and validate CSRF tokens on registration POSTs, and consider rate-limiting/account approval for public self-registration.

finding: WebGoat JWT Voting Endpoint Accepts HS512 Tokens Signed With Weak Secret 'victory'
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWT voting lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Use a high-entropy server-side JWT signing key from secret management, rotate existing keys, bind JWT claims to the authenticated principal, and reject client-controlled privilege claims.

finding: WebGoat JWT Voting Endpoint Accepts Unsigned alg=none access_token Cookies
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWT voting lesson / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable alg=none, allowlist only the intended signed algorithm, and never trust JWT privilege claims unless the signature and session binding are verified.

finding: WebGoat JWT Voting Lesson Accepts Forged Admin Tokens via alg=none and Weak HS512 Secret
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWTVotesEndpoint / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Reject unsigned JWTs, rotate the hard-coded HMAC secret to a strong server-side secret, pin the expected algorithm, and derive admin authorization server-side instead of trusting client claims.

finding: WebWolf Accepts WebGoat Credentials and Issues Weak Session Cookie Flags
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Enforce HTTPS and set Secure and SameSite on WEBWOLFSESSION; review whether WebWolf should share the WebGoat credential store.

finding: WebGoat JWT Voting Accepts Unsigned alg=none Admin Token via Cookie Channel
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWT Lesson / JWTVotesEndpoint on Apache Tomcat:8080
remediation: Reject unsigned JWTs, pin accepted algorithms server-side, validate signatures for all token sources including cookies, and bind JWT claims to the authenticated session.

finding: WebGoat WebWolf Integration Leaks Internal Loopback Service URL
target: OWASP WebGoat / WebWolf integration on Apache Tomcat:8080
remediation: Configure WebGoat to redirect only to the public WebWolf origin and avoid exposing internal loopback addresses or username handoff parameters.

finding: WebGoat Serves Obsolete jQuery 2.1.4 and jQuery UI 1.10.3 Libraries
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 static JavaScript on Apache Tomcat:8080
remediation: Remove intentionally vulnerable aliases from production builds and upgrade jQuery to 3.7.1+ and jQuery UI to 1.13.3+.

finding: Reachable DOM XSS Sink in WebGoat Fragment Test Route
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Backbone frontend on Apache Tomcat:8080

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator Env and ConfigProps Disclosure Still Present
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat:8080
remediation: Restrict actuator endpoints to authenticated administrators and expose only required health probes.

finding: Host Header Injection Controls Absolute Redirect Locations on WebGoat and WebWolf
target: OWASP WebGoat/WebWolf on Apache Tomcat:8080

finding: WebWolf File Upload CSRF Creates Files in Victim Account
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Require CSRF tokens on multipart upload endpoints and set SameSite=Lax/Strict on WEBWOLFSESSION cookies.

finding: WebGoat WebWolf Bridge Leaks Internal Loopback URL and Username in Redirect
target: OWASP WebGoat/WebWolf 2025.3 Cross-Service Integration on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36

finding: WebGoat and WebWolf Login CSRF Enables Session Swapping
target: OWASP WebGoat/WebWolf 2025.3 / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36

finding: Constrained Server-Side Request Forgery in WebGoat SSRF Lesson Allows Outbound HTTP Fetch

finding: WebGoat and WebWolf Logout CSRF Allows Forced Session Termination
target: OWASP WebGoat/WebWolf 2025.3 / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator Environment Exposure
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Restrict actuator endpoints to authenticated administrators or bind them to a private management interface.

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator Health Leaks Database and Filesystem Metadata
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable detailed health output for unauthenticated users and protect actuator health with Spring Security.

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator ConfigProps Exposure
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable configprops exposure or require administrative authentication for all actuator endpoints.

finding: Unauthenticated Spring Boot Actuator Discovery Index Reveals Management Endpoints
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot Actuator on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable actuator discovery or expose only minimal endpoints to authenticated users.

finding: WebGoat Serves Obsolete jQuery 2.1.4
target: OWASP WebGoat static JavaScript / jQuery 2.1.4
remediation: Upgrade jQuery to a currently supported 3.x release and regression-test existing UI code.

finding: WebGoat Serves Obsolete jQuery UI 1.10.3
target: OWASP WebGoat static JavaScript / jQuery UI 1.10.3

target: OWASP WebGoat/WebWolf on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Enable HTTPS, set Secure and SameSite on session cookies, and disable URL-based session tracking.

finding: Public WebGoat Self-Registration Without CSRF Creates Usable Accounts

finding: JWT Voting Lesson Accepts HS512 Tokens Signed With Weak Hard-Coded Secret 'victory'
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWTVotesEndpoint:8080
remediation: Replace the hard-coded JWT HMAC secret with a high-entropy rotated secret and enforce strict claim validation.

finding: JWT Voting Lesson Accepts Forged alg=none Admin Token

remediation: Reject unsigned JWTs and enforce an allowlist of expected signing algorithms during JWT decoding.

finding: Missing Function-Level Access Control on Hidden Menu Completion Endpoint
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Missing Function Access Control Lesson:8080
remediation: Apply server-side authorization checks to hidden/admin functions and do not trust client-supplied hidden menu values.

finding: Authenticated WebGoat Error Responses Disclose Full Java Stack Traces
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable stack traces in HTTP error responses and return generic error messages to clients.

target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 Web UI:8080

target: OWASP WebWolf File Upload on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Restrict upload content types/extensions, store outside the web root, and serve user uploads as attachments with nosniff.

finding: WebWolf Uploaded Files Are Public and Cross-User Accessible by Username/Filename
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Require authentication and enforce ownership checks before serving uploaded files; avoid exposing usernames and raw filenames as authorization selectors.

finding: Authenticated WebWolf Error Responses Disclose Full Java/Spring Stack Traces
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Boot on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Disable stack traces in HTTP error responses and return generic error bodies for WebWolf errors.

finding: WebWolf Uploaded Files Are Public and Cross-User Accessible by Username/Filename
target: OWASP WebWolf / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Require authentication and enforce ownership checks before serving uploaded files; avoid exposing usernames and raw filenames as authorization selectors.

finding: WebGoat and WebWolf Logout CSRF Allows Forced Session Termination
target: OWASP WebGoat/WebWolf 2025.3 / Spring Security on Apache Tomcat 10.1.36
remediation: Require a valid CSRF token for logout and disable GET-based logout; set SameSite cookies as defense-in-depth.

finding: JWT JKU Header Drives Server-Side JWKS Fetch and Leaks Fetch Errors
target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWT JKU Lesson on Apache Tomcat:8080
remediation: Never fetch JWKS from arbitrary JWT header URLs; pin trusted issuers/JWKS endpoints and return generic validation errors without reflecting fetch exceptions.

target: OWASP WebGoat 2025.3 JWT JKU Lesson on Apache Tomcat:8080
remediation: Disable arbitrary JKU resolution; pin JWKS URLs to trusted issuers, block link-local/loopback/private address resolution, and suppress URL-specific exception messages.

WebWolf authenticated file upload lacks CSRF protection: a cross-origin multipart POST can create a file in the victim's WebWolf account without a token.
The WebGoat-to-WebWolf integration endpoint leaks internal loopback service URLs and the authenticated username in a redirect Location.
WebGoat and WebWolf login forms lack CSRF protections, allowing login CSRF/session swapping into an attacker-controlled account.
Spring Security OAuth client integration is enabled and initiates a GitHub OAuth flow with state and redirect_uri parameters.
WebGoat and WebWolf logout endpoints are CSRFable: cross-origin GET/POST can invalidate a victim session without a CSRF token.

WebGoat still exposes unauthenticated auth-adjacent metadata and Spring Boot actuator routes useful for session/auth attack planning.
Authenticated low-privilege WebGoat session can access the missing-function access-control hidden-menu endpoint using hiddenMenu1/hiddenMenu2 parameter names.
The JWT voting lesson stores the issued token in an `access_token` cookie; replacing that cookie with an HS512 token signed using weak secret `victory` and admin=true completes the assignment.
GoatUtils.js contains an additional DOM-based unsafe HTML sink reachable from WebGoat client actions that can render server-controlled or user-controlled text directly via jQuery .html().
Active Directory and Windows lateral movement tooling is not applicable to the currently exposed target surface.
WebGoat’s /WebGoat/WebWolf integration route leaks its internal WebWolf base URL and may trust the username query parameter when redirecting to WebWolf.
WebWolf on port 9090 shares the WebGoat account database and issues WEBWOLFSESSION without Secure/SameSite attributes.
WebWolf and WebGoat protected method-mismatch routes leak newly issued session identifiers in URL-rewritten Location headers when cookies are not yet established.
Tomcat/Spring absolute redirect generation on WebGoat or WebWolf may be Host-header controlled, enabling open-redirect style phishing and possible poisoning of cross-service authentication redirects.
The WebGoat SSRF lesson is constrained to specific allowlisted exercise URLs and cannot be used as a general internal network pivot to localhost actuator or WebWolf.

The JWT JKU endpoint attempts loopback/WebWolf/metadata URLs too, making it a more flexible internal probe than the SSRF lesson even if it only returns JWKS fetch errors.
